create_transform: create an ImgPilRandomPhotometric transform with a given probability to randomly apply photometric image transforms
instantiate_from_config: instantiate ImgPilRandomPhotometric from a configuration dictionary with a probability parameter
apply_photometric_transforms: apply random photometric transforms including AutoContrast, RandomPosterize, RandomSharpness, and RandomSolarize to an image
register_transform: register ImgPilRandomPhotometric as a named transform using the register_transform decorator
call_transform: call ImgPilRandomPhotometric on a PIL image to apply random photometric augmentations
